state.timing_policy: Observed motion is transient; the external controller schedules the chosen maneuver.

maneuver.instructions: Select a safe maneuver for the obstacle. Let the external controller determine timing.

criteria.jump: Clear a ground hazard or a bird that blocks both standing and ducking.
criteria.duck: Pass below a bird that only blocks standing.
criteria.keep_running: The obstacle clears the standing dinosaur.

jump_profile.instructions: Assuming a jump, select its trajectory. Use a short jump only for a single small cactus.
